messageText:
Bas kuch din me aapka bday aane wala hai and uske liye shayad hum hi jyada excited hai... waise iss message me bohot galtiyaaan hongi {jaise mere andar hai} but i'll try to improve it taaki kabhi to ye perfect bann paaye
That aside ye site maine sirf aapko ye batane ke liye banai hai taaki aap khush raho, aapne kal bataya tha ki aapka mood aacha nahi hai , and hum aapka mood aacha nahi kr sake the so here i am on my duty taaki aapka mood aacha ho sake
well hum jyada kuch bol nahi paa rahe aur likh to paate nahi hai , but still aap feelings to samajh hi jaaogi...and if god's grace is with me...i know ki ab aap thoda sa khush jaroor ho gayi hogii...
and sorry ha humko pata hai kbhi kbhi hum thoda over kr dete hai jisse shyd aap awkward ho jaati ho , but i cant control that , you know aapse thodi jyada baat ho jaaye iske liye kr deta hu shyad, but i'll try ki aisa naa ho...
so at the end bass yahi kehna chahunga ki aap khush raha kro ....and w8 kro apne bday ka...even tough hum jyada nahi kr sake (cause mere pe jyada paisa saved nhi tha...and i'm not a rich brat) but i'll make sure ki aisa din jaroor aaye jb hum legit aapko aapke poori life ka sabse best bday gift de aur aapko legit duniya me kuch one of the best and unique gifts and experience ho taaki aap genuine me sabse jyada special feel kro uss din....
so please tb tk w8 kree aur khusshhh raheee...
tb tk chaandni is signing off....
aur haa ab vindhyachal ke saath saath amritsar bhi jaana hai...
